hero_main.alt: Diverse business team in modern office hallway

feature_collaboration.alt: Coworkers collaborating in open space office

general: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Public Sans' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.
Implement a 'Light Mode' first approach. The dashboard sidebar should be dark (#0F172A) for contrast.
Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Dashboard overview.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Do not use gradients for text or backgrounds unless specified in 'visual_enhancers'.

specific_pages.landing: Create a high-conversion landing page with a sticky header, hero section with the 'hero_main' image, features grid, and a pricing section.
specific_pages.dashboard: Sidebar navigation on the left. Top bar with search and profile. Main content area with summary widgets.
specific_pages.meeting_details: Split view: Left side for the full transcript (scrollable), Right side for the AI Summary and Action Items (sticky).
specific_pages.record_meeting: Center the recording interface. Use a visual waveform animation (CSS or Canvas) to indicate activity.

accessibility: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards.
All images must have descriptive alt text.
Interactive elements must be keyboard navigable.

universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. No purple/teal gradients everywhere.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Do not center align the app container.
